The Elite Soccer Training Difference

REAL DEVELOPMENT. REAL CONFIDENCE.

Elite Soccer Training uses technical repetition, game-realistic training, confidence building, speed of play, competitive standards, and small group attention to help youth players develop with purpose.

Coach Hugo's Background

Originally from South Gate, Los Angeles, Coach Hugo Chaparro brings 15 years of coaching experience across boys, girls, coed middle school, and high school soccer. He currently coaches with Desert Empire Surf and Desert Christian Academy.

Coaching Philosophy

Every session is built around accountability, detail, intensity, and game-like repetition. The goal is to help players improve their technique, confidence, speed of play, decision-making, and competitive habits.

Why EST Started

Elite Soccer Training was created to give Coachella Valley players a focused, professional small group environment to grow, compete, and reach higher levels.

Meet Coach Hugo

Programs

Age-based soccer development groups.

Future Elite builds foundation for ages 9-12. Elite Performance pushes ages 13-18 with speed, intensity, finishing, and game-realistic repetition.

Technical foundation

Future Elite (Ages 9-12)

01

Small group development for young players building confidence, clean technique, and control.

  • First touch and ball mastery
  • Passing and receiving
  • Coordination and movement
  • Confidence on the ball

Game-realistic intensity

Elite Performance (Ages 13-18)

02

High-intensity training for older players developing speed, decision making, and match execution.

  • Speed of play and finishing
  • Decision making under pressure
  • Agility and intensity
  • Game-realistic development
